status: frozen by the Gate-2 vote (v16 §19, 2026-08-19); not production-closed
encoding: RFC 8949 core deterministic encoding; untagged COSE structures
external_aad: zero-length for every Sig_structure in this profile

vectors.title: Unattributed COSE_Sign1, classical suite, server challenge present
vectors.notes: credential_hash null; Nonce REQUIRED for unattributed proofs; hs_unattributed_key_set carries exactly the plan's one component key.

vectors.title: Authenticated hybrid COSE_Sign, one logical signer group, two components
vectors.notes: Both components share hs_logical_signer_group 1 and count as one logical signer. credential_hash binds the presented credential.

vectors.title: Response proof COSE_Sign1 signed by the enrolled service key
vectors.notes: cti echoes the request_id; capnp_schema_id/body carry the response root type and exact response bytes; hs_unattributed_key_set is forbidden in this profile. Its originating request (P-2) carries a null response_binding, so a full response verifier runs aud/cti/schema/null-binding comparisons (all equal).

vectors.title: Authenticated COSE_Sign1 with an encrypted response_binding (unary, ML-KEM-768)
vectors.notes: response_binding: root type id, response_kind=unary, protection_mode=encrypted, and the ML-KEM-768 recipient (alg -70200).

vectors.title: Authenticated COSE_Sign1 with a cleartext stream-setup response_binding
vectors.notes: response_kind=stream_setup and protection_mode=cleartext are orthogonal; a cleartext binding carries a null KEM recipient.

vectors.title: TokenBoundAndApproved: two distinct logical signer groups
vectors.notes: Two groups, two principals, one approval each; not a countersignature.

vectors.title: Bound response proof whose response_binding equals the originating request (P-4)
vectors.notes: Realized response binding equals P-4's request binding field-for-field; cti echoes the request_id.

vectors.title: Hybrid unattributed COSE_Sign; two embedded keys in plan order, verified 1:1
vectors.notes: hs_unattributed_key_set carries the Ed25519 then ML-DSA-65 public keys in the plan's component order; each signature verifies against its embedded key.

vectors.title: Session-bound classical proof whose exp equals the authoritative session expiry
vectors.notes: Bound to the user-session credential (sid); proof exp 1786000020 <= session exp 1786000020 <= credential exp 1786000030, valid at verifier_now 1786000015.

vectors.title: Workload-session-bound classical proof (workload primary key; exp within the workload session)
vectors.notes: Bound to the workload credential (workload_session_id); cnf resolves the workload primary enrollment (principal workload-1); proof exp 1786000022 <= workload session exp 1786000022 <= credential exp 1786000030.
